metadata.remarks: Container Runtime and Isolation defines the trust properties required to enforce confinement of containerized workloads at runtime. This pattern focuses on kernel interaction, namespace separation, and runtime enforcement mechanisms that prevent container escape, privilege escalation, and unintended lateral movement.

components.title: Kernel Boundary Enforcement
components.description: Constrains containerized workloads to prevent unsafe interaction with the host kernel.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Container workloads are prevented from invoking unsafe kernel interfaces or escaping confinement.

components.title: Namespace and Resource Isolation
components.description: Enforces separation of process, network, filesystem, and resource namespaces between containers.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Namespace and resource isolation mechanisms prevent cross-container interference.

components.title: Runtime Privilege Restriction
components.description: Limits runtime privileges available to containers and containerized processes.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Runtime enforcement prevents container workloads from acquiring excessive privileges.
